engagement_tiers.audience: founder inquiry (DM, comment with a real requirement)
engagement_tiers.template: Brief acknowledgment of what they brought. The short version: one team carries framing, behavior, product, execution, and handoff inside a single delivery loop. The people who frame the requirement are the people who build it. If the problem is too entangled to split across vendors, bring it here. We study it, build the system, and hand it back in a form you can run. [Link to /start or scoped entry point]

engagement_tiers.audience: operator inquiry (technical question about the loop, handoff, or studio)
engagement_tiers.template: Specific technical acknowledgment. Here's how the loop runs in your case: Requirement — [specific framing of their question]. System — [specific design decision]. Build — [specific engineering approach]. Handoff — [specific deliverable, e.g., Ownership Transfer Pack]. [Detail or link to case study showing this approach]
Restrained acknowledgment. The loop is the studio. Four stages, one team, one handoff. Here's [link to relevant content — most relevant landing page section, blog post, or social post]

engagement_tiers.audience: industry observer (deep engagement from a peer in design/engineering/AI space)
engagement_tiers.template: Longer reflection if appropriate, drawing on delivery-loop principles. Acknowledge their specific observation. [Link to relevant deeper content — notebooklm source, case study, or longer essay]

engagement_tactics.purpose: Weekly share of a delivery-loop principle applied to a current observation
Engage thoughtfully with adjacent communities (design circles, AI/automation founders)
Long-form update on what the studio is shipping, learning, building toward
Monthly live Q&A where founders can bring requirements openly

data.voice_discipline: PASS — uses preferred vocabulary, no prohibited terms, founder-side systems translator voice
response_do: Acknowledge the specific observation plainly before responding
Point to the next concrete step (a link, an action, a reference)
Maintain calm confidence — not celebration theater
Use evidence close to the claim (cite the loop, cite the studio's approach)
Be willing to say 'this is not for you' if applicable
Treat every interaction as evidence the studio respects the founder's time
response_dont: Don't use superlatives or celebration language
Don't name the internal methodology (Krebs origins, consciousness layer) in public copy
Don't use prohibited terms (consciousness-aligned, disruptive, best-in-class, full-service agency)
Don't fake expertise — say 'I don't know' if you don't
Don't engage in long debates; redirect to relevant content
Don't make promises the studio can't keep
